text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Is he still not done?!
This is starting to wear me out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだこりないの～！？
ミソギもさすがに疲れてきたよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I can't believe there's a prankster even worse than Misogi...
text_block_list.orig_text: ミソギより上のいたずらっ子がいたなんて……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Say what?!
My tricks are way better than this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに～！？
ミソギは負けてないからね！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I can keep going!
We've gotta say bye-bye to all the ghosts!
Misogi, Kyoka, let's all be brave together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミもがんばれるよ！
幽霊さんたち、
お見送りしなきゃだもん！
ミソギちゃん、
キョウカちゃん、
一緒にがんばろ～！
